polygonSharing.measurement: Inspection elapsedMs measures compile only. After is cold; before is warm. Fingerprinting and expanded-corner hashing are outside the timer. Render hash changes intentionally with indexed representation.

coldProfile.note: Before color lookup. Sampled self time includes idle and GC. Diagnostic profile, not a paired benchmark.

renderHashExperiment.note: Exploratory identity format only; hashes intentionally differ. No production implementation. GC outside timed sections. Prototype is little-endian only.

portablePrototype.note: Exploratory identity format only; hashes intentionally differ. No production implementation. GC outside timed sections. DataView encodes little-endian, canonicalizes signed zero and uses one nonfinite marker.

cacheRead16Profile.note: Sampled self time grouped approximately by progress intervals. Profiler starts just before the compile timer; phase boundaries can differ slightly. Diagnostic only.

immediateShadingExperiment.status: rejected; production source and prior warm cache restored
immediateShadingExperiment.reason: Synthetic raster timing improved slightly, but the full cold run did not improve and peak RSS increased. Review also found a reentrant scratch-ownership regression in the discarded prototype.
immediateShadingExperiment.validation: 35 raster and texture-preservation tests pass on restored source; final four tests rerun after removing an unnecessary callback-order assertion. Typechecking and independent reviews pass.
